import json
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from catboost import CatBoostClassifier
import os
import warnings
from datetime import datetime

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Create submission directory if it doesn't exist
os.makedirs("submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load training data
with open("./input/train/train.json", "r") as f:
    train_data = json.load(f)

# Load test data
with open("./input/test/test.json", "r") as f:
    test_data = json.load(f)

# Convert to DataFrames
train_df = pd.DataFrame(train_data)
test_df = pd.DataFrame(test_data)

# Define numerical metadata features that exist in both train and test
metadata_features = [
    "requester_account_age_in_days_at_request",
    "requester_days_since_first_post_on_raop_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_comments_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_comments_in_raop_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_posts_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_posts_on_raop_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_subreddits_at_request",
    "requester_upvotes_minus_downvotes_at_request",
    "requester_upvotes_plus_downvotes_at_request",
    "unix_timestamp_of_request",
    "unix_timestamp_of_request_utc",
]

# Add categorical feature
categorical_features = ["requester_user_flair"]

# Add boolean feature
boolean_features = ["post_was_edited"]

# Filter to only features that exist in both datasets
common_features = [
    f for f in metadata_features if f in train_df.columns and f in test_df.columns
]

common_categorical = [
    f for f in categorical_features if f in train_df.columns and f in test_df.columns
]

common_boolean = [
    f for f in boolean_features if f in train_df.columns and f in test_df.columns
]


# Function to extract time-based features from unix timestamps
def extract_time_features(df):
    features = pd.DataFrame()

    # Use UTC timestamp if available, otherwise fall back to regular timestamp
    timestamp_col = (
        "unix_timestamp_of_request_utc"
        if "unix_timestamp_of_request_utc" in df.columns
        else "unix_timestamp_of_request"
    )

    if timestamp_col in df.columns:
        # Convert to datetime
        timestamps = pd.to_datetime(df[timestamp_col], unit="s", errors="coerce")

        # Day of week (0=Monday, 6=Sunday)
        features["day_of_week"] = timestamps.dt.dayofweek

        # Hour of day (0-23)
        features["hour_of_day"] = timestamps.dt.hour

        # Month (1-12)
        features["month"] = timestamps.dt.month

        # Weekend indicator (Saturday=5, Sunday=6)
        features["is_weekend"] = (timestamps.dt.dayofweek >= 5).astype(int)

        # Business hours indicator (9 AM - 5 PM)
        features["is_business_hours"] = (
            (timestamps.dt.hour >= 9) & (timestamps.dt.hour <= 17)
        ).astype(int)

        # Morning indicator (6 AM - 12 PM)
        features["is_morning"] = (
            (timestamps.dt.hour >= 6) & (timestamps.dt.hour <= 12)
        ).astype(int)

        # Evening indicator (6 PM - 11 PM)
        features["is_evening"] = (
            (timestamps.dt.hour >= 18) & (timestamps.dt.hour <= 23)
        ).astype(int)

        # Year
        features["year"] = timestamps.dt.year

        # Quarter
        features["quarter"] = timestamps.dt.quarter

    return features


# Function to extract text features
def extract_text_features(df):
    features = pd.DataFrame()

    # Use request_text_edit_aware for both train and test
    text_col = "request_text_edit_aware"

    if text_col in df.columns:
        # Text length
        features["text_length"] = df[text_col].fillna("").str.len()

        # Word count
        features["word_count"] = df[text_col].fillna("").str.split().str.len()

        # Character count excluding spaces
        features["char_count_no_space"] = (
            df[text_col].fillna("").str.replace(r"\s", "", regex=True).str.len()
        )

        # Punctuation ratio
        features["punctuation_ratio"] = df[text_col].fillna("").str.count(
            r"[^\w\s]"
        ) / (features["text_length"] + 1)

        # Question mark count (requests often have questions)
        features["question_mark_count"] = df[text_col].fillna("").str.count(r"\?")

        # Exclamation mark count (enthusiasm indicator)
        features["exclamation_mark_count"] = df[text_col].fillna("").str.count(r"!")

        # Average word length
        features["avg_word_length"] = features["text_length"] / (
            features["word_count"] + 1
        )

        # Colon count (often used in explanations)
        features["colon_count"] = df[text_col].fillna("").str.count(r":")

        # Dollar sign count (mentions of money)
        features["dollar_sign_count"] = df[text_col].fillna("").str.count(r"\$")

        # Thank-related words
        features["thank_word"] = (
            df[text_col]
            .fillna("")
            .str.lower()
            .str.contains(r"\b(thank|thanks|thankful)\b")
            .astype(int)
        )

        # Please word
        features["please_word"] = (
            df[text_col].fillna("").str.lower().str.contains(r"\bplease\b").astype(int)
        )

        # Sorry/apology words
        features["sorry_word"] = (
            df[text_col]
            .fillna("")
            .str.lower()
            .str.contains(r"\b(sorry|apologize|apology)\b")
            .astype(int)
        )

        # Promise words
        features["promise_word"] = (
            df[text_col]
            .fillna("")
            .str.lower()
            .str.contains(r"\b(promise|guarantee|will)\b")
            .astype(int)
        )

        # Food-related words
        features["food_word"] = (
            df[text_col]
            .fillna("")
            .str.lower()
            .str.contains(r"\b(food|meal|dinner|lunch|hungry|starving)\b")
            .astype(int)
        )

        # Story words (indicates longer narrative)
        features["story_word"] = (
            df[text_col]
            .fillna("")
            .str.lower()
            .str.contains(r"\b(because|since|so|story|reason)\b")
            .astype(int)
        )

    return features


# Function to extract ratio features
def extract_ratio_features(df):
    features = pd.DataFrame()

    # Comment to post ratio
    if (
        "requester_number_of_comments_at_request" in df.columns
        and "requester_number_of_posts_at_request" in df.columns
    ):
        features["comment_to_post_ratio"] = df[
            "requester_number_of_comments_at_request"
        ] / (df["requester_number_of_posts_at_request"] + 1)

    # RAOP comment ratio
    if (
        "requester_number_of_comments_in_raop_at_request" in df.columns
        and "requester_number_of_posts_on_raop_at_request" in df.columns
    ):
        features["raop_comment_to_post_ratio"] = df[
            "requester_number_of_comments_in_raop_at_request"
        ] / (df["requester_number_of_posts_on_raop_at_request"] + 1)

    # Upvote to downvote ratio
    if (
        "requester_upvotes_plus_downvotes_at_request" in df.columns
        and "requester_upvotes_minus_downvotes_at_request" in df.columns
    ):
        features["upvote_to_downvote_ratio"] = (
            df["requester_upvotes_plus_downvotes_at_request"]
            + df["requester_upvotes_minus_downvotes_at_request"]
        ) / (
            df["requester_upvotes_plus_downvotes_at_request"]
            - df["requester_upvotes_minus_downvotes_at_request"]
            + 1
        )

    # Account age to RAOP activity ratio
    if (
        "requester_account_age_in_days_at_request" in df.columns
        and "requester_days_since_first_post_on_raop_at_request" in df.columns
    ):
        features["account_age_ratio"] = df[
            "requester_account_age_in_days_at_request"
        ] / (df["requester_days_since_first_post_on_raop_at_request"] + 1)

    return features


# Function to extract interaction features between text and user activity
def extract_interaction_features(df, text_features):
    features = pd.DataFrame()

    # Text length * number of posts
    if (
        "text_length" in text_features.columns
        and "requester_number_of_posts_at_request" in df.columns
    ):
        features["text_length_x_posts"] = (
            text_features["text_length"] * df["requester_number_of_posts_at_request"]
        )

    # Text length * number of comments
    if (
        "text_length" in text_features.columns
        and "requester_number_of_comments_at_request" in df.columns
    ):
        features["text_length_x_comments"] = (
            text_features["text_length"] * df["requester_number_of_comments_at_request"]
        )

    # Text length * number of subreddits
    if (
        "text_length" in text_features.columns
        and "requester_number_of_subreddits_at_request" in df.columns
    ):
        features["text_length_x_subreddits"] = (
            text_features["text_length"]
            * df["requester_number_of_subreddits_at_request"]
        )

    # Word count * number of posts
    if (
        "word_count" in text_features.columns
        and "requester_number_of_posts_at_request" in df.columns
    ):
        features["word_count_x_posts"] = (
            text_features["word_count"] * df["requester_number_of_posts_at_request"]
        )

    # Word count * number of comments
    if (
        "word_count" in text_features.columns
        and "requester_number_of_comments_at_request" in df.columns
    ):
        features["word_count_x_comments"] = (
            text_features["word_count"] * df["requester_number_of_comments_at_request"]
        )

    # Text length * upvotes
    if (
        "text_length" in text_features.columns
        and "requester_upvotes_plus_downvotes_at_request" in df.columns
    ):
        features["text_length_x_upvotes"] = (
            text_features["text_length"]
            * df["requester_upvotes_plus_downvotes_at_request"]
        )

    return features


# Extract time features
train_time_features = extract_time_features(train_df)
test_time_features = extract_time_features(test_df)

# Extract text features
train_text_features = extract_text_features(train_df)
test_text_features = extract_text_features(test_df)

# Extract ratio features
train_ratio_features = extract_ratio_features(train_df)
test_ratio_features = extract_ratio_features(test_df)

# Extract interaction features
train_interaction_features = extract_interaction_features(train_df, train_text_features)
test_interaction_features = extract_interaction_features(test_df, test_text_features)

# Combine metadata and text features
train_features = train_df[common_features].copy()
test_features = test_df[common_features].copy()

# Handle missing values for numerical features
train_features = train_features.fillna(0)
test_features = test_features.fillna(0)

# Add categorical features (handle missing values)
if common_categorical:
    train_cat = train_df[common_categorical].fillna("None")
    test_cat = test_df[common_categorical].fillna("None")
    train_features = pd.concat(
        [train_features.reset_index(drop=True), train_cat.reset_index(drop=True)],
        axis=1,
    )
    test_features = pd.concat(
        [test_features.reset_index(drop=True), test_cat.reset_index(drop=True)],
        axis=1,
    )

# Add boolean features
if common_boolean:
    train_bool = train_df[common_boolean].fillna(False).astype(int)
    test_bool = test_df[common_boolean].fillna(False).astype(int)
    train_features = pd.concat(
        [train_features.reset_index(drop=True), train_bool.reset_index(drop=True)],
        axis=1,
    )
    test_features = pd.concat(
        [test_features.reset_index(drop=True), test_bool.reset_index(drop=True)],
        axis=1,
    )

# Add time features
train_features = pd.concat(
    [train_features.reset_index(drop=True), train_time_features.reset_index(drop=True)],
    axis=1,
)
test_features = pd.concat(
    [test_features.reset_index(drop=True), test_time_features.reset_index(drop=True)],
    axis=1,
)

# Add text features
train_features = pd.concat(
    [train_features.reset_index(drop=True), train_text_features.reset_index(drop=True)],
    axis=1,
)
test_features = pd.concat(
    [test_features.reset_index(drop=True), test_text_features.reset_index(drop=True)],
    axis=1,
)

# Add ratio features
train_features = pd.concat(
    [
        train_features.reset_index(drop=True),
        train_ratio_features.reset_index(drop=True),
    ],
    axis=1,
)
test_features = pd.concat(
    [test_features.reset_index(drop=True), test_ratio_features.reset_index(drop=True)],
    axis=1,
)

# Add interaction features
train_features = pd.concat(
    [
        train_features.reset_index(drop=True),
        train_interaction_features.reset_index(drop=True),
    ],
    axis=1,
)
test_features = pd.concat(
    [
        test_features.reset_index(drop=True),
        test_interaction_features.reset_index(drop=True),
    ],
    axis=1,
)

# Ensure columns match
train_features = train_features[test_features.columns]

# Prepare target variable
y = train_df["requester_received_pizza"].astype(int)

# Split into train and validation
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    train_features, y, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y
)

# Identify categorical columns
cat_columns = [col for col in X_train.columns if X_train[col].dtype == "object"]

# Train CatBoost classifier
model = CatBoostClassifier(
    iterations=500,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    depth=6,
    loss_function="Logloss",
    verbose=False,
    random_state=42,
    task_type="CPU",
    cat_features=cat_columns,
)

model.fit(X_train, y_train, eval_set=(X_val, y_val), use_best_model=True)

# Predict on validation set
val_predictions = model.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]

# Calculate AUC-ROC
auc_score = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_predictions)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC: {auc_score:.4f}")

# Predict on test set
test_predictions = model.predict_proba(test_features)[:, 1]

# Create submission file
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {"request_id": test_df["request_id"], "requester_received_pizza": test_predictions}
)

# Save submission
submission.to_csv("submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Number of predictions: {len(submission)}")
